description:
A shareable OpenSearch synonym_graph (or legacy synonym) token filter. SynonymSets belong to an Organization; the qualified name {organizationName}-{name} is what a TextAnalyzer references via {"$ref": "{organizationName}-{name}"} inside its settings.filter registry map to bring this filter into the analyzer. Use the filter only in the TextAnalyzer's analyzer.default_search chain — see TextAnalyzer for its placement.

Example — OpenSearch native synonym syntax: a, b, c for equivalent (bidirectional) and a, b => c, d for explicit (directional) expansion. The definition field is a JSON object — paste OpenSearch examples directly without escaping:

{
  "organizationName": "biomed",
  "name": "medical_terms",
  "definition": {
    "type": "synonym_graph",
    "synonyms": [
      "tumor, neoplasm, cancer",
      "AD => Alzheimer's disease"
    ]
  }
}

Tuning suggestions:

  • Multi-word synonyms — prefer synonym_graph (it handles phrases correctly).
  • Disable bidirectional expansion (only the LHS is a synonym source): set "expand":false in the definition.
  • Tolerate malformed rule lines without failing the whole filter: set "lenient":true in the definition.

Cannot be deleted while any persisted resource references it. See the OpenSearch synonym_graph filter docs for the full parameter list (synonyms, format, expand, lenient, etc.).

id.description: The unique ID of this synonym set.

organizationName.description: The name of the Organization this resource belongs to. Immutable after creation.

name.description: The resource name. Must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits, and underscores. Unique within the organization and immutable after creation. Used as part of the qualified name ({organizationName}-{name}) when referenced by other resources.

description.description: Optional description of the synonym set.

definition.description: Required. The full OpenSearch token filter definition as a JSON object, exactly as documented for the synonym_graph / synonym token filters. Synapse parses this to confirm it's valid JSON and otherwise passes it through to AOSS verbatim. AOSS Serverless does not support file-based parameters — use inline synonyms; AOSS rejects synonyms_path at index-build time.

etag.description: Synapse employs an Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) scheme.

createdOn.description: The date this resource was created.

createdBy.description: The ID of the user that created this resource.

modifiedOn.description: The date this resource was last modified.

modifiedBy.description: The ID of the user that last modified this resource.
